title: TMEFF1 is a neuron-specific restriction factor for herpes simplex virus
model: SK-N-SH Cas9+ neuroblastoma, GeCKO v2 genome-wide library (two half-libraries A and B)
contrast: GFP-high vs unsorted control after HSV-1-GFP, enrichment; each half-library 1 vs 1
paper_method: Genome-wide CRISPR screen (GFP-high sort), authors' pipeline plus extensive validation
paper_calls: TMEFF1 nominated and validated as the restriction factor
barcs_calls: 0 genes at empirical FDR 0.10 in either half; TMEFF1 ranks mid-pack (13,497/A, 17,405/B)
named_hits: TMEFF1 not recovered (readthrough MSANTD3-TMEFF1 only weakly enriched, p 0.03-0.10)
verdict: BARCS does not recover the validated hit TMEFF1 from the deposited single-replicate half-library counts: no gene passes the clean 1,000-control empirical null, and TMEFF1 ranks mid-pack with the model-FDR 'hits' being sparse-count artifacts; the genome-wide screen with one library per condition is underpowered, so these are screening-level calls and the paper's hit rested on its own pipeline plus validation.
